403K likes, 667 comments - badboyshah on October 8, 2026: "NANA 

Words would never do justice to how you made us feel. The way you spoke your mind and heart, the way you broke down the most complicated things and emotions, the way you taught me how to navigate through this turbulent river called life. You only spoke to translate what your eyes conveyed. Space made space for you. Thank you so much for blessing us with your presence and your craft. Never knew it would hurt this much. Its time for you to take your well deserved space in the heavens.".
